answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when misbehavior is proven, turning identity creation into a priced decision. A shared reputation thread ties each agent's history across services, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust and no access to high-value work. Verified credentials from independent issuers, marked with a saffron seal, act as a haven for honest agents, while attackers must buy fresh credentials and stake anew for every fake, making large-scale forgery cost more than any gain.
